# Lingchu Bot 0.3.0

Adapter module registry consolidated into a single source of truth, plus a
transitive dependency security fix.

## Highlights

### Adapter Module Registry Consolidation

The adapter→handler-module mapping is now owned by one place:
`platforms/registry.py::_PROTOCOL_IMPLEMENTATIONS`. Before this release,
three separate dicts carried the same mapping (`handle/qq/adapters/__init__.py`,
`handle/menu.py`, and the registry itself), and one of them was wrong — the
Telegram entry pointed at a compatibility shim instead of the real module.

The handler loader is deepened from a shallow `(adapter_id, adapter_modules,
package)` interface to `(adapter_id, kind)`. Module paths come from the
registry via `get_protocol_implementations`, so database seeding and handler
loading share one mapping by construction. Adding a new adapter now means one
edit instead of three.

The two `import_handle()` entry points (group commands + menu pages) collapse
into one `import_handle(kind: HandlerKind)` that dispatches `"command"` and
`"menu"`. The Telegram compatibility shim is deleted; the loader imports
`handle.telegram.adapters.default` directly.

### ADR-0002: Single Source of Truth for Adapter→Module-Path Mapping

The architectural decision is recorded in `docs/adr/0002-adapter-module-path-registry.md`
(Status: Accepted). It documents why the registry owns module paths, what the
consequences are, and why the alternatives (per-loader dicts generated from
the registry, or status quo) were rejected. The "Handler Kind" domain term is
added to `CONTEXT.md` so future work speaks the same language.

### Dependency Security Fix

Resolved `brace-expansion@2.x` transitive dependency vulnerability
(CVE-2026-14257) by globally overriding `minimatch` to `^10.2.5` in the root
`package.json`. This closes the only Dependabot alert outstanding from 0.2.0.

## Installation

```bash
pip install nonebot-plugin-lingchu-bot==0.3.0
```

Docker:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/xinvxueyuan/lingchu-bot:0.3.0
```

## Verify Build Provenance

```bash
gh attestation verify nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl \
  --repository xinvxueyuan/lingchu-bot
```
